[issue by rbasamoyai]
### Bug Description

When firing a big cannon produced with Create Big Cannons, the game crashes due to apparently not satisfying a vertex data format introduced by the Sodium 0.8 1.21.1 backport. (See also https://github.com/Cannoneers-of-Create/CreateBigCannons/issues/938).

### Reproduction Steps

1. Create a NeoForge 1.21.1 mod instance with Create Big Cannons v5.11.5 (including dependencies) and Sodium 0.8.12-alpha.4.
2. Launch Minecraft, create a new world.
4. Build a big cannon and fill it with propellant (such as powder charges). (See the Create Big Cannons ponders or an online tutorial for the basic specifics.)
5. Fire the big cannon.
6. The game should crash.
